g.text: FIGURE 2: FIRST-ORDER ODE SOLUTION ENGINE & INTEGRATING FACTOR ARCHITECTURE
Variable Separable, Homogeneous, Linear First-Order ODEs & Bernoulli's Non-Linear Transformation Pipeline
GATE 2027 TITANS ENGINE
SPEC: ULTRA-HD 4K BLUEPRINT
1. VARIABLE SEPARABLE & REDUCIBLE FORMS
CANONICAL SEPARABLE FORM: f(x) dx + g(y) dy = 0
Direct integration yields the solution:
∫ f(x) dx + ∫ g(y) dy = C
• Rapid check: Factorize dy/dx = f(x) · g(y). If possible, separate: dy / g(y) = f(x) dx.
REDUCIBLE FORM: dy/dx = f(ax + by + c)
Standard substitution technique:
Let v = ax + by + c ⟹ dv/dx = a + b(dy/dx) ⟹ dy/dx = (1/b)(dv/dx - a)
⟹ (1/b)(dv/dx - a) = f(v) ⟹ dv / [a + b f(v)] = dx (SEPARABLE!)
Integrate directly in v, then restore v = ax + by + c.
EXAM DRILL: dy/dx = (x + y + 1)²
Put v = x + y + 1 ⟹ dv/dx = 1 + dy/dx ⟹ dv/dx - 1 = v²
⟹ dv / (v² + 1) = dx ⟹ arctan(v) = x + C
VERDICT: arctan(x + y + 1) = x + C (Solves in 20 seconds!)
2. HOMOGENEOUS ODE TRANSFORMATION
HOMOGENEOUS TEST: dy/dx = f(x, y) / g(x, y)
f(x, y) and g(x, y) are homogeneous functions of the SAME degree n:
f(λx, λy) = λⁿ f(x, y) ⟹ dy/dx = F(y/x)
• Quick test: Sum of powers in each monomial term must be identical.
CANONICAL TRANSFORMATION: y = v x
Differentiate: dy/dx = v + x (dv/dx)
Equate to F(v): v + x (dv/dx) = F(v) ⟹ x (dv/dx) = F(v) - v
⟹ dv / [F(v) - v] = dx / x (SEPARATED IN v & x!)
Integrate both sides and replace v with y/x.
NON-HOMOGENEOUS FRACTION: dy/dx = (a₁x + b₁y + c₁) / (a₂x + b₂y + c₂)
• Case 1 (a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂): Shift origin: x = X + h, y = Y + k to eliminate c₁, c₂.
• Case 2 (a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = m): Substitute v = a₁x + b₁y (Reduces to separable!).
• Case 3 (b₁ = -a₂): Rearrange into cross-multiplication: ALWAYS EXACT!
3. FIRST-ORDER LINEAR PIPELINE (LEIBNIZ)
CANONICAL FORM: dy/dx + P(x) y = Q(x)
Condition: Coefficient of dy/dx must be strictly 1.
INTEGRATING FACTOR: IF = e^(∫ P(x) dx)
GENERAL SOLUTION: y · IF = ∫ [Q(x) · IF] dx + C
INVERTED FORM: dx/dy + P(y) x = Q(y)
Used when equation is linear in x but non-linear in y:
INTEGRATING FACTOR: IF = e^(∫ P(y) dy)
GENERAL SOLUTION: x · IF = ∫ [Q(y) · IF] dy + C
HIGH-SPEED EXPONENT SIMPLIFICATION ARSENAL
• e^(ln f(x)) = f(x)
• e^(k ln f(x)) = e^(ln [f(x)]^k) = [f(x)]^k
• e^(-ln x) = e^(ln x^(-1)) = 1/x (NOT -x! #1 Exam Blunder)
• e^(2 ln(sec x)) = sec² x
4. BERNOULLI'S NON-LINEAR TRANSFORMATION ENGINE
A. CANONICAL BERNOULLI EQUATION
Non-linear first order ODE of the form:
dy/dx + P(x) y = Q(x) yⁿ (n ≠ 0, 1)
• If n = 0 ⟹ dy/dx + P y = Q (Standard linear ODE).
• If n = 1 ⟹ dy/dx + (P - Q) y = 0 (Separable ODE).
• If n ≠ 0, 1 ⟹ Non-linear due to yⁿ factor on RHS!
THE 3-STEP LINEARIZING TRANSFORMATION:
STEP 1: Divide entire equation by yⁿ:
y^(-n) (dy/dx) + P(x) y^(1-n) = Q(x)
STEP 2: Substitute v = y^(1-n):
dv/dx = (1 - n) y^(-n) (dy/dx) ⟹ y^(-n) (dy/dx) = (1 / (1-n)) dv/dx
STEP 3: Resulting Standard Linear ODE in v:
dv/dx + (1 - n) P(x) v = (1 - n) Q(x)
Now solve via standard IF = e^(∫ (1-n)P dx) and back-substitute v = y^(1-n)!
B. INVERTED BERNOULLI EQUATION (IN x)
When powers of x appear non-linearly:
dx/dy + P(y) x = Q(y) xⁿ
• Divide by xⁿ: x^(-n) (dx/dy) + P(y) x^(1-n) = Q(y).
• Substitute u = x^(1-n) ⟹ du/dy = (1-n) x^(-n) dx/dy.
du/dy + (1 - n) P(y) u = (1 - n) Q(y)
CRITICAL EXAM IDENTIFICATION TRICK:
EXAMPLE: (x + 2y³) dy/dx = y
dy/dx = y / (x + 2y³) is heavily non-linear in y. Invert!
dx/dy = (x + 2y³) / y = (1/y)x + 2y²
⟹ dx/dy - (1/y)x = 2y² (LINEAR IN x!)
IF = e^(∫ -1/y dy) = e^(-ln y) = 1/y
⟹ x(1/y) = ∫ 2y²(1/y) dy = ∫ 2y dy = y² + C ⟹ x = y³ + C y
C. STEP-BY-STEP BERNOULLI DRILL
PROBLEM: dy/dx + (1/x) y = x² y⁶
1. Identify: P(x) = 1/x, Q(x) = x², n = 6.
2. Divide by y⁶: y^(-6) y' + (1/x) y^(-5) = x²
3. Substitute v = y^(1-6) = y^(-5):
4. Standard linear ODE in v:
-1/5 dv/dx + (1/x) v = x² ⟹ dv/dx - (5/x) v = -5 x²
5. Integrating Factor:
6. General solution in v:
7. Multiply by x⁵ and back-substitute v = y^(-5):
VERDICT: Solved flawlessly in 7 systematic steps.
